title: The Year the Bubble Peaked
narrative: The NASDAQ hits its all-time high in March, then everything that was built on hype starts to wobble. AOL buys Time Warner in the largest merger in history. Napster makes music free for 80 million people. Broadband quietly passes five million homes and the always-on Internet begins.
